project-management/discovery/interview-s.description: Turns customer interview notes into evidenced themes, an opportunity tree and follow-up questions. Use when you have just run interviews, need to show what customers said, or must find evidence gaps before the next round.

project-management/discovery/jtbd-worksh.description: Plans and runs a 2, 4 or 8-hour Jobs-To-Be-Done workshop: switch interviews, forces of progress, scored outcome statements. Use when you need to know why customers switch, or to ground strategy in jobs before writing PRDs.

project-management/discovery/metrics-das.description: Designs a product metrics dashboard in four layers (North Star, inputs, guardrails, operational) with owners, comparisons and cadence, and audits the spec. Use when building a launch dashboard or pruning one nobody uses.

project-management/discovery/opportunity.description: Maps one outcome to customer opportunities, 3+ solutions each and assumption tests, then audits the tree. Use when prioritizing discovery work, mapping solutions to a problem, or checking whether a roadmap moves outcomes.

project-management/discovery/plan-grilli.description: Interrogate a plan, design or idea one round of questions at a time until every decision is settled. Use when stress-testing a plan before building, when a design feels underspecified, or turning a fuzzy workflow into a spec.

project-management/discovery/pre-mortem.description: Runs a pre-mortem that sorts launch risks into evidenced tigers, paper tigers and unspoken elephants, each with an owner. Use when a big launch, build or migration is coming, or the team has a bad feeling it cannot name.

project-management/discovery/value-propo.description: Maps one segment's jobs, pains and gains against your product's relievers and creators and checks fit. Use when testing whether an offer matches what customers care about, or positioning a product for one segment.

project-management/execution/activation-.description: Designs and analyzes activation funnels: stage conversion, drop-off, bottlenecks and the aha event that predicts retention. Use when a funnel leaks, signups grow but activation is flat, or you must pick an activation event.

project-management/execution/agents-in-t.description: Run delivery when AI coding and ops agents take tickets. Use when setting agent delegation policy, writing agent-ready tickets, planning review capacity, measuring agent vs human delivery, or rolling agents out safely.

project-management/execution/ai-feature-.description: Extends a PRD with model choice, eval and safety plan, guardrails, cost model and rollout gates for an AI or ML feature. Use when specifying any LLM, RAG, agent or ML feature, or replacing a rules-based flow with a model.

project-management/execution/backlog-ref.description: Grade stories against INVEST, split them vertically or as tracer bullets, and enforce Definition of Ready and Done. Use when refining a backlog, splitting an oversized story, or checking sprint readiness.

project-management/execution/beta-progra.description: Plan and run a closed beta: cohorts, exit gates agreed before recruiting, weekly cadence and a Greenlight/Extend/Pivot/Kill memo. Use when running a closed beta or design-partner program before general availability.

project-management/execution/brainstorm-.description: Draft and score quarterly OKRs: a qualitative objective, measurable key results and a counter-metric. Use when setting or reviewing a team's OKRs before they are committed, or when KRs read like a task list.

project-management/execution/create-prd.description: Write an 8-section product requirements document, framing the problem before the solution. Use when specifying a new product or a large feature that needs engineering, design and business aligned on one document.

project-management/execution/customer-fe.description: Cluster, score and route inbound feature requests from support, sales, NPS and exec asks, and draft honest replies. Use when a feedback queue needs triaging or a customer needs a defensible yes, no or exploring answer.

project-management/execution/cycle-time-.description: Compute lead time, cycle time, throughput, WIP, aging WIP and a cumulative flow diagram from issue status history. Use when diagnosing slow delivery, setting WIP limits or preparing a flow review.

project-management/execution/daci-framew.description: Assign Driver, Approver, Contributor and Informed roles for the decisions that keep stalling, then roll the chart out. Use when decisions thrash, ownership is unclear after a reorg, or a new team needs decision rights.

project-management/execution/decision-qu.description: Turn a blocked decision into an async questionnaire a stakeholder can answer without a meeting. Use when you need someone else's input to decide, a meeting would be overkill, or answers from several people must be consolidated.

project-management/execution/dependency-.description: Track cross-team dependencies in one JSON file and get a risk-ranked blocker list, the longest hand-off chain and a Mermaid graph. Use when several teams depend on each other and you need to know what to chase this week.
